transcript.en: Ah Caroline... come on in.
Sit down.
Thanks.
So how is the dissertation planning going?
Well Dr Schulmann, I'm still having a lot of trouble deciding on a title.
transcript.zh: 舒尔曼博士，我在选择题目上还有许多困扰。

transcript.en: Well, that's perfectly normal at this stage.
And this is what your tutorials will help you to do.
transcript.zh: 这就是辅导课要帮你做的

transcript.en: Right.
What we'll do is jot down some points that might help you in your decision.
transcript.zh: 我们要做的是记下一些可能对你的选择有帮助的要点

transcript.en: First of all, you have chosen your general topic area, haven't you?
transcript.zh: 首先，你已经选好了大概的题目范围了，是吗？

transcript.en: Yes, it's the fishing industry.
Oh, yes, that was one of the areas you mentioned.
transcript.zh: 是的，这是你提到过的一个领域。

transcript.en: Now, what aspects of the course are you good at?
transcript.zh: 课程的哪方面是你擅长的

transcript.en: Well, I think I'm coping well with the statistics, and I'm never bored by it.
transcript.zh: 我认为我擅长统计，我从不对此感到厌烦

transcript.en: Good.
Anything else?
Well, I found computer modeling fascinating.
transcript.zh: 我发现计算机建模很有意思

transcript.en: I have no problem following what's being taught, whereas quite a few of my classmates find it difficult.
transcript.zh: 我完全能跟上老师讲的内容，而我的很多同学却认为它很难。

transcript.en: Well, that's very good.
Do you think these might be areas you could bring into your dissertation?
transcript.zh: 你觉得这些可以用到你的论文里吗

transcript.en: Oh, yes, if possible.
It's just that I'm having difficulty thinking how I can do that.
transcript.zh: 如果有可能的话，我只是在如何处理上有问题，

transcript.en: You see I feel I don't have sufficient background information.
transcript.zh: 我觉得我没有足够的背景知识

transcript.en: I see.
Well, do you take notes?
I'm very weak at note-taking.
My teachers always used to say that.
Well, I think you really need to work on these weaknesses before you go any further.
transcript.zh: 我觉得你得先解决了这些缺点再接着往下进行

transcript.en: What do you suggest?
Well, I can go through the possible strategies with you and let you decide where to go from there.
transcript.zh: 我可以和你查阅一下可行的策略，让你决定里面哪个适合

transcript.en: Okay, thanks.
Well, some people find it helpful to organise peer-group discussions.
transcript.zh: 有些人觉得组织同龄人的小组讨论很有帮助

transcript.en: You know, each week a different person studies a different topic and shares it with the group.
transcript.zh: 每周由不同的人研究一个不同的话题并与小组的其他人分享

transcript.en: Oh right.
It really helps build confidence, you know, having to present something to others.
transcript.zh: 这对树立信心有帮助，把某些事情介绍给别人

transcript.en: I can see that.
The drawback is that everyone in the group seems to share the same ideas... they keep being repeated in all the dissertations.
transcript.zh: 缺点是小组里的每个人似乎都有相同的观点，所有的论文都在重复这些观点。

transcript.en: Okay.
You could also try a service called "Student Support".
transcript.zh: 你还可以尝试一项“学生支持”服务

transcript.en: It's designed to give you a structured programme over a number of weeks to develop your skills.
transcript.zh: 它通过几周的结构课程提升你的技能

transcript.en: Sounds good.
Yes, unfortunately there are only a few places.
transcript.zh: 是的，不幸的是名额有限

transcript.en: But it's worth looking into.
Yes, of course.
I know I have got to work on my study skills.
transcript.zh: 我知道我得改进我的学习技巧

transcript.en: And then there are several study skills books you can consult.
transcript.zh: 有一些学习技巧的书供你查阅

transcript.en: Right.
They'll be a good source of reference but the problem is they are sometimes too general.
transcript.zh: 它们是很好的参考来源，但问题是范围有时太宽泛了。

transcript.en: Yes, that's what I've found.
Other than that I would strongly advise quite simple ideas like using a card index.
transcript.zh: 除此之外，我强烈建议一些简单的主意，像是使用卡片索引。

transcript.en: Well, yes, I've never done that before.
It's simple, but it really works because you have to get points down in a small space.
transcript.zh: 它很简单，但是很有用，因为你不得不把要点写在一个小的空间上。

transcript.en: Another thing I always advise is don't just take your notes and forget about them.
transcript.zh: 另一件我总是说的事是不要只记笔记而将它们抛在脑后。

transcript.en: Read everything three times.
That'll really fix them in your mind.
Yes, I can see it'd take discipline but...
transcript.zh: 是的，我明白这个方法需要训练，但是……

transcript.en: Well, if you establish good study skills at this stage they'll be with you all your life.
transcript.zh: 如果你在这个阶段养成了好的学习技巧，你将终生受用，

transcript.en: Oh, yes, I completely agree.
It's just that I don't seem to be able to discipline myself.
transcript.zh: 我完全同意，但是我觉得我不能约束自己，

transcript.en: I need to talk things over.
Well, we'll be continuing these tutorials of course. Let's arrange next month's now.
transcript.zh: 我们肯定会继续这些辅导。让我们现在安排下个月的事情。

transcript.en: Let's see, I can see you virtually any time during the week starting 22nd January.
transcript.zh: 让我看看。我看到你从1月22日开始的那周都有空。

transcript.en: What about the 24th?
I'm free in the afternoon.
Sorry, I'm booked then.
What about the following day?
The Thursday?
I can make the morning.
Fine, we'll go for the 25th then.
That's great, thanks.
